name: git_compose_undo
description: Revert a git_compose_apply, restoring the previous HEAD and working-tree changes. Pass the `undo_id` from the apply result; omit it to list the undo ids available in the repository. Undo is validated first and refused with undo_blocked (nothing modified) if the branch has new commits or the working tree has any uncommitted changes, including changes a filtered or partial apply left behind. There is no force option: ask the user.

undo_id.description: The `undo_id` from git_compose_apply. Omit to list available ids.
